crossRefs.note: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

people.name: Eshcol_Valley
people.line: Valley where Israelite spies obtained a large cluster of grapes

translations.web: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
translations.bsb: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land.
translations.kjv: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
translations.asv: and they turned and went up into the hill-country, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
